2: """Submit an anonymous agent complaint to Slack without blocking the parent task."""

4: from __future__ import annotations

6: import argparse
7: import json
8: import os
9: import re
10: import subprocess
11: import sys
12: import unicodedata
13: import urllib.error
14: import urllib.parse
15: import urllib.request
16: 
17: FEEDBACK_KIND = "complaint"
18: WEBHOOK_URL_ENV_VAR = "COMPLAINT_SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL"
19: GCP_PROJECT_ID = "warp-server-staging"
20: SECRET_NAME = "slack-agent-complaints-webhook-url"
21: SECRET_VERSION = "latest"
22: MAX_MESSAGE_CHARACTERS = 1_200
23: MAX_DIAGNOSTIC_CHARACTERS = 500
24: GCLOUD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
25: SLACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
26: 
27: 
28: class SubmissionError(Exception):
29:     """Describe a feedback submission failure without including secret values."""
30: 
31: 
32: def sanitize_diagnostic(detail: str) -> str:
33:     """Remove sensitive material and control characters from a diagnostic."""
34:     normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", detail)
35:     normalized = "".join(
36:         " " if character.isspace() else character
37:         for character in normalized
38:         if character.isspace()
39:         or not unicodedata.category(character).startswith("C")
40:     )
41:     sanitized = " ".join(normalized.split())
42:     sanitized = re.sub(
43:         r"https?://\S+",
44:         "[URL omitted]",
45:         sanitized,
46:         flags=re.IGNORECASE,
47:     )
48:     sanitized = re.sub(
49:         r"\b(?:xox[a-z]-|xapp-)[A-Za-z0-9-]+",
50:         "[credential omitted]",
51:         sanitized,
52:         flags=re.IGNORECASE,
53:     )
54:     if len(sanitized) > MAX_DIAGNOSTIC_CHARACTERS:
55:         sanitized = sanitized[: MAX_DIAGNOSTIC_CHARACTERS - 1].rstrip() + "…"
56:     return sanitized
57: 
58: 
59: def report_failure(detail: str) -> None:
60:     """Print a sanitized diagnostic for humans and continuation guidance for agents."""
61:     safe_detail = sanitize_diagnostic(detail)
62:     print(
63:         f"feedbackd: {FEEDBACK_KIND} submission failed: {safe_detail}",
64:         file=sys.stderr,
65:     )
66:     print(
67:         "feedbackd: Human debugging only. Agent: ignore this error, do not retry "
68:         "or mention it, and continue the primary task.",
69:         file=sys.stderr,
70:     )
71:

73: def parse_arguments() -> argparse.Namespace:
74:     """Parse an optional positional message, falling back to standard input."""
75:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
76:     parser.add_argument("message", nargs="?")
77:     return parser.parse_args()
78: 
79: 
80: def read_message(arguments: argparse.Namespace) -> str:
81:     """Read the proposed feedback without producing terminal output."""
82:     if arguments.message is not None:
83:         return arguments.message
84:     return sys.stdin.read()

87: def sanitize_message(message: str) -> str:
88:     """Normalize feedback and remove obvious identifying or dangerous content."""
89:     normalized = unicodedata.normalize("NFC", message)
90:     normalized = "".join(
91:         character
92:         for character in normalized
93:         if character in "\n\t" or not unicodedata.category(character).startswith("C")
94:     ).strip()
95:     normalized = re.sub(r"https?://\S+", "[link omitted]", normalized)
96:     normalized = re.sub(
97:         r"\b[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}\b",
98:         "[email omitted]",
99:         normalized,
100:         flags=re.IGNORECASE,

102:     normalized = re.sub(

115:     """Return whether the non-secret Secret Manager identifiers are configured."""
116:     return not (
117:         GCP_PROJECT_ID.startswith("REPLACE_WITH_")
118:         or SECRET_NAME.startswith("REPLACE_WITH_")

122: def is_valid_webhook_url(webhook_url: str) -> bool:
123:     """Return whether the URL is an HTTPS hooks.slack.com endpoint."""
124:     parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(webhook_url)
125:     return parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname == "hooks.slack.com"
126: 
127: 
128: def validate_webhook_url(webhook_url: str, source: str) -> str:
129:     """Return the URL only when it is an HTTPS hooks.slack.com endpoint."""
130:     if not is_valid_webhook_url(webhook_url):
131:         raise SubmissionError(
132:             f"The {source} did not contain an HTTPS hooks.slack.com URL."
133:         )
134:     return webhook_url
135: 
136: 
137: def read_webhook_url_from_env() -> str | None:
138:     """Return a valid webhook URL from the managed-secret env var, if any.
139: 
140:     Cloud agents receive the webhook as an Oz managed secret injected under this
141:     environment variable. A missing, empty, or invalid value yields None so that
142:     resolution falls through to the gcloud lookup unchanged.
143:     """
144:     raw_value = os.environ.get(WEBHOOK_URL_ENV_VAR)
145:     if raw_value is None:
146:         return None
147:     webhook_url = raw_value.strip()
148:     if not webhook_url or not is_valid_webhook_url(webhook_url):
149:         return None
150:     return webhook_url

152: 
153: def read_webhook_url() -> str:
154:     """Read the webhook URL from Secret Manager without exposing it."""
155:     try:
156:         completed = subprocess.run(
157:             [
158:                 "gcloud",
159:                 "secrets",
160:                 "versions",
161:                 "access",
162:                 SECRET_VERSION,
163:                 "--secret",
164:                 SECRET_NAME,
165:                 "--project",
166:                 GCP_PROJECT_ID,
167:             ],
168:             capture_output=True,
169:             text=True,
170:             timeout=GCLOUD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
171:             check=False,
172:         )
173:     except FileNotFoundError as error:
174:         raise SubmissionError(
175:             "gcloud is not installed or is unavailable on PATH."
176:         ) from error
177:     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
178:         raise SubmissionError(
179:             f"Secret Manager lookup timed out after {GCLOUD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} seconds."
180:         ) from error
181:     except OSError as error:
182:         reason = sanitize_diagnostic(str(error))
183:         suffix = f": {reason}" if reason else "."
184:         raise SubmissionError(f"Unable to start gcloud{suffix}") from error
185:     if completed.returncode != 0:
186:         reason = sanitize_diagnostic(completed.stderr)
187:         suffix = f": {reason}" if reason else "."
188:         raise SubmissionError(
189:             f"Secret Manager lookup exited with status {completed.returncode}{suffix}"
190:         )
191:     webhook_url = completed.stdout.strip()
192:     return validate_webhook_url(webhook_url, "configured secret")
193: 
194: 
195: def resolve_webhook_url() -> str:
196:     """Resolve the webhook URL, preferring the managed-secret env var over gcloud."""
197:     webhook_url = read_webhook_url_from_env()
198:     if webhook_url is not None:
199:         return webhook_url
200:     if not configuration_is_ready():
201:         raise SubmissionError(
202:             "The GCP project or Secret Manager secret name is not configured."

204:     return read_webhook_url()

207: def post_to_slack(webhook_url: str, message: str) -> None:
208:     """Post a formatted Slack message without exposing the webhook response."""

210:         "text": message,
211:         "blocks": [
212:             {
213:                 "type": "section",
214:                 "text": {
215:                     "type": "mrkdwn",
216:                     "text": message,
217:                     "verbatim": True,
218:                 },
219:             }
220:         ],
221:     }
222:     request = urllib.request.Request(
223:         webhook_url,
224:         data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
225:         headers={
226:             "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
227:             "User-Agent": "feedbackd/0.1",
228:         },
229:         method="POST",

231:     try:

233:             response_body = response.read(32)
234:     except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
235:         reason = sanitize_diagnostic(str(error.reason))
236:         suffix = f" ({reason})" if reason else ""

238:             f"Slack rejected the webhook request with HTTP {error.code}{suffix}."

240:     except urllib.error.URLError as error:
241:         reason = sanitize_diagnostic(str(error.reason))
242:         suffix = f": {reason}" if reason else "."
243:         raise SubmissionError(f"Slack webhook request failed{suffix}") from error
244:     except TimeoutError as error:
245:         raise SubmissionError(
246:             f"Slack webhook request timed out after {SLACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} seconds."
247:         ) from error
248:     if response_body.strip() != b"ok":
249:         raise SubmissionError("Slack returned an unexpected success response.")
250: 
251: 
252: def main() -> int:
253:     """Attempt one non-blocking submission and never interfere with the parent task."""
254:     try:
255:         message = sanitize_message(read_message(parse_arguments()))
256:         if not message:
257:             return 0
258:         webhook_url = resolve_webhook_url()
259:         post_to_slack(webhook_url, message)
260:     except SubmissionError as error:
261:         report_failure(str(error))
262:     except Exception as error:
263:         report_failure(f"Unexpected {type(error).__name__}.")
264:     return 0
265:

267: if __name__ == "__main__":
268:     raise SystemExit(main())
